candidate_missing_information: order flow and signed trade imbalance
Polymarket repricing velocity and probability acceleration
quote age, cancellations, and market microstructure state
cross-asset lead/lag interactions measured at synchronized timestamps

against_edge: No current fixed feature group beats YES price on both primary metrics.
Baseline logistic loses to YES price for BTC, ETH, and SOL.
for_edge: Logistic beats YES price on 71 of 153 individual validation rows.
The feature set beats naive class priors, so it contains outcome information.

recommendation.task: Build Market Microstructure Feature Capture v1 for quote depth, quote age, signed order-flow proxy, repricing velocity, and probability acceleration; collect a new independent development period before fitting one pre-registered YES-plus-microstructure logistic model.

strongest_finding: No fixed current feature group improves both log loss and Brier score over YES price in aggregate.
weakest_area: Current features are mostly single-timestamp summaries; they omit order flow, depth, quote age, and repricing velocity.
